description.value: Don Chepe's is a family-owned Salvadorean restaurant that has been serving the Lower Mainland since 2015, built around generations-old recipes from El Salvador. The kitchen is helmed by the owner-chef, known locally as the Queen of the Pupusas, whose handmade corn-flour pupusas are the signature draw. The menu spans traditional appetizers, soups, tacos, and Salvadorean breakfast plates, with pickup and delivery available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms Don Chepe's is an active Salvadorean restaurant (opened 2015) with pickup and delivery ordering available, matching the OSM amenity=restaurant tag. There is a material address mismatch: OSM records '1122 Fifth Avenue, Vancouver' but the website consistently and clearly states the address as '1-228 Schoolhouse Street, Coquitlam' across both the front page and contact subpage — the website value is used as authoritative. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: Significant address mismatch: OSM records '1122 Fifth Avenue' in Vancouver, but the website consistently lists '1-228 Schoolhouse Street, Coquitlam' on both the homepage and contact page. The OSM record's community is also listed as 'Vancouver' rather than Coquitlam. The OSM pin coordinates (49.2063, -122.9284) correspond to New Westminster / Burnaby area, not central Vancouver — the record likely needs its OSM address and community corrected to Coquitlam.
OSM has no phone number; website provides (604) 544-1644 (telephone) and (604) 612-2322 (mobile).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with an operating website, hours of operation, and online ordering — clearly open and publicly accessible to touring cyclists.
